free_tier.stated: The docs state 'No hardware yet? console.tenstorrent.com lets you run LLM inference and image and video generation in the browser, backed by Tenstorrent hardware.' The console catalogue adds 'Cloud hardware access and advanced workflows (deployments, agents) available in staged rollout.' The Cloud Services Agreement says 'Certain Cloud Services and Models may be designated as fee-free or otherwise available without triggering a payment for a limited time or based on usage limits.' No catalogue price or free-tier size is published on the pages read.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a machine, not an object
per_object_cap.notes: The primary constraint is the virtual machine hardware specification.

retention.stated: not applicable: the unit is a machine or an account, not stored bytes
retention.notes: a machine record: what is lost is the running process, not a stored object

egress.terms: The agreement states 'Fees are published at console.tenstorrent.com/dashboard/pricing, in the Console, or specified in an Order Form.' That pricing page answers a login wall and publishes no egress allowance or price to an anonymous reader.

interface_detail: The docs describe an in-browser console; models.dev lists an OpenAI-compatible REST API at https://console.tenstorrent.com/v1.
tooling: not stated in the finding; the provider documents no client
chaining: The console is the cheapest way to touch Tensix silicon and it chains with the open-source TT-Metalium and TT-Forge stacks, which compile locally at no cost. It breaks at scale: anything beyond a demo needs a Cloud instance or the Koyeb rental, both billed.
limits_note: no rate, session length, token allowance or concurrency figure is published for the free console, so the constraint that fails first cannot be named.
binding_note: no rate, session length, token allowance or concurrency figure is published for the free console, so the constraint that fails first cannot be named.

identity_cost.detail: The Cloud Services Agreement states 'Customer must have an Account to use the Cloud Services'; the signup form itself was not read, so which identifiers the account asks for is unverified.

reliability_note: unverified: https://console.tenstorrent.com/v1 answered HTTP 404 on 2026-11-24; the browser console was not exercised without an account
